manifest.build_scope: Frozen UI lab with UI source commit plus recorded baseline bootstrap/network inputs; later network-policy commit is not part of this binary.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Frozen UI overlay base a3afc206f742f0a59da6e65d609ddf1df3c7326d plus 16 explicit live UI overrides (including sidebar_metal.h/mm), with committed own installer/stager hooks; concurrent network-policy changes excluded. native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

build_scope: UI source commit with recorded frozen bootstrap/build tools from d23f232; current-main network policy excluded from this binary and acceptance.
contracts: Footer pin/settings and all workspace dots use plain RustActionView hosts with Rust action state instead of Button/ButtonController instances. Header actions retain their preceding Rust host. Native comparison retains SceneGlyphButton.

Rust owns normal/emoji/chrome action preferred-size metrics and enabled/focused/on/visual/input state. Workspace emoji text remains presentation data from the existing native domain store; the same glyph scene builder/vector fallback painter and explicit native FocusRing/window/AX/input adapters remain.

Shell workspace/pin/settings pointers and selection/swipe projections use View adapters and action accessors. Existing workspace/profile/menu and persistence callbacks remain; tests retain original state/lifecycle assertions through default-accessibility delivery instead of ButtonTestApi.

Ancestor transforms do not notify descendant visibility. The viewport callback synchronously retires clipped Rust footer actions, including while a GPU update is queued and in fallback. Cancel is idempotent to avoid idle repaint recursion. Native comparison skips this Rust scan. Mouse/gesture admission checks visible bounds; AX default first reveals a drawn/enabled target before ordinary event delivery.

New real-footer acceptance checks actual host types, role/name, normal/emoji metrics and view replacement, a real inactive-dot Cocoa menu/profile target, disabled/pin AX, workspace Space/AX selection, scroll-out-and-back cancellation, offscreen AX reveal/selection and idle frame stability. An actual action callback deletes its own host in both modes. Existing native mouse footer thumb/emoji/select/settings/pin/fallback tests retain their assertions.

The native menu test helper observes NSMenu tracking and schedules inspection in Cocoa tracking/default modes, then closes the real menu. It rejects delayed work after its invocation ends; production menu nesting policy is unchanged.

This full source includes preceding sidebar/footer/palette viewport, resize-host and header-action migrations plus raw-trackpad/capture corrections. Native control/node/container/menu/window/input ownership beyond these families remains. No dependency, browser service/store/admission or persistence policy change.
limits: Full automated acceptance does not establish complete functional/manual/release parity.
Other button/row/control/node/container/menu/input/window ownership still requires migration. Native View identity and FocusRing remain explicit adapters here.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidates, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
No controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation/input-latency or memory gain established.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside the frozen UI lab checkpoint.

initial_probe.note: Both initial gates timed out in the new native-menu case: the Cocoa context-menu loop intentionally disallows Chromium application tasks, so its queued inspection/close never ran. The final test uses a native tracking-mode observer; it still opens the real menu and checks the inactive workspace/profile target. Production menu nesting behavior was unchanged.

gpu_log_diagnostics.scope: Diagnostics remain in retained logs; launcher/case success does not diagnose or resolve them.
